items.name: Dagger
items.description: This small, bladed weapon is held in one hand and used to stab a creature in close combat. It can also be thrown.

items.name: Rapier
items.description: The rapier is a long and thin piercing blade with a basket hilt. It is prized among many as a dueling weapon.

items.name: Leather Armor
items.description: A mix of flexible and molded boiled leather, a suit of this type of armor provides some protection with maximum flexibility.

items.name: Manacles (Average) (Marked with the Symbol of the Scarlet Triad)
items.description: You can manacle someone who is willing or otherwise at your mercy as an exploration activity taking 10-30 seconds depending on the creature's size and how many manacles you apply. A two-legged creature with its legs bound takes a –15-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds, and a two-handed creature with its wrists bound has to succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:5] any time it uses a manipulate action or else that action fails. This DC may be higher depending on how tightly the manacles constrain the hands. A creature bound to a stationary object is immobilized. For creatures with more or fewer limbs, the GM determines what effect manacles have, if any. Freeing a creature from average manacles requires four successful @Check[thievery|dc:27|traits:action:pick-a-lock] checks.

items.name: Thieves' Tools
items.description:
You need thieves' tools to Pick Locks or Disable Devices (of some types) using the Thievery skill.

If your thieves' tools are broken, you can repair them by replacing the lock picks with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Thieves' Toolkit (Replacement Picks)]{Replacement Picks} appropriate to your tools; this doesn't require using the Repair action.

defensiveAbilities.name: Deny Advantage
defensiveAbilities.description: The sneak isn't Off-Guard to Hidden, Undetected, or flanking creatures of 6th level or lower, or creatures of 6th level or lower using surprise attack.

defensiveAbilities.name: Mobility
defensiveAbilities.description: When the sneak takes a Stride action to move half their Speed or less, that movement does not trigger reactions.

defensiveAbilities.name: Nimble Dodge
defensiveAbilities.description:
Requirement A sneak can't use this reaction while encumbered.

Trigger The sneak is hit by an attack made by a creature the sneak can see.

Effect The sneak gains a +2 circumstance bonus to their Armor Class against the triggering attack.

offensiveAbilities.name: Efficient Capture
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The sneak has manacles in hand and is adjacent to a creature.

Effect The sneak attempts to bind the creature's wrists or ankles with the manacles. If the sneak succeeds at an attack roll with a +16 modifier against the target's AC, they apply the manacles.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sneak Attack
offensiveAbilities.description: The scarlet triad sneak deals an extra 2d6 precision damage to Off-Guard creatures.

offensiveAbilities.name: Surprise Attack
offensiveAbilities.description: In the first round of combat, creatures that haven't acted yet are Off-Guard to the sneak.
